arabic text: ZINDAA(N) HAI SAKINA HAI\nANDHERA HAI JAFA HAI
english translation text: THERE IS A PRISON, THERE IS SAKINA, THERE IS DARKNESS THERE IS SORROW

arabic text: KYA QABR KA MANZAR HAI\nUJALA NA HAWA HAI
english translation text: LOOK AT THE STATE OF HER GRAVE\nTHERE IS NO LIGHT, THERE IS NO AIR

arabic text: NEEND AATI NAHI BACHON KO JAB TAK NA HO MAADAR
english translation text: CHILDREN CANNOT SLEEP UNTIL THEY HAVE THEIR MUMS NEXT TO THEM
